label: Phase 3 numbers (committed runs, Sep 2026) and the re-runs' scores. Claude Code re-scores the demo set, both arms (brief A4).
reading: At neither stand size can the stands be shown to group plots that are alike on the ground better than a randomly placed copy of the same stand map, and at neither size can the stand types be shown to match the field types better than chance. None of the ten planned tests survives the correction for running several tests. This says the stands cannot be told from chance with this field data. It does not say they are poor: with 20 villages the data could miss a real effect of modest size. AlphaEarth has not been scored yet; Claude Code scores it, with a declaration written first.
